Pewe Social Welfare Society

Registration No. F/3584/RTG and MH/5602/RTG

PSWS General Election for Pewe 2026

How to vote Vote kaise karein

There are two things to do, on two different days. Register your name now, and vote on election day. Each takes about a minute. Do kaam hain, do alag din. Abhi apna naam register kijiye, aur election ke din vote kijiye. Dono mein ek ek minute lagta hai.

Voting is open Friday 4 September from 8:00 in the morning until Saturday 5 September at 6:00 in the evening, India time. Voting Friday 4 September subah 8:00 baje se Saturday 5 September shaam 6:00 baje tak khuli hai, India ke time se.

Register before then. After voting closes, no vote can be given. Usse pehle register kar lijiye. Voting band hone ke baad koi vote nahi diya ja sakta.

The 17 elected members will hold office for a term of two years. Jo 17 log chune jaayenge, woh do saal ke liye rahenge.

Part one, now. Register your name Pehla kaam, abhi. Apna naam register kijiye

  1. Open the link the society sent to the group. Society ne group mein jo link bheja hai, use kholiye.

    The same link is used again on election day. Keep it. Yahi link election ke din bhi kaam aayega. Ise sambhal kar rakhiye.

  2. Type your full name. Apna poora naam likhiye.

    This is the name every voter will see on the ballot, so write it in full, the way people know you. Yahi naam sabhi voters ko ballot par dikhega, isliye poora likhiye, jaise log aapko jaante hain.

  3. Type your phone number. Apna phone number likhiye.

    Use the number the society has for you. Spaces, a plus sign or a zero in front make no difference. Wahi number likhiye jo society ke paas hai. Space, plus ya aage zero lagane se koi farak nahi padta.

  4. Choose the country you are living in. Jis mulk mein aap rehte hain woh chuniye.

    Asked here and nowhere else. The society only counts how many are voting from each country, and it is never joined to your choices. Yeh sirf yahin poocha jayega. Society sirf ginti karti hai ki kis mulk se kitne log vote de rahe hain, aur ise aapki pasand se kabhi nahi joda jaata.

  5. Press Register. Your voting code appears on the screen. Register dabaiye. Aapka voting code screen par aa jayega.

  6. Take a screenshot of that code, or write it down. Us code ka screenshot le lijiye, ya likh lijiye.

    It is shown once only and cannot be shown again. If you lose it, message the election admin. Yeh sirf ek baar dikhta hai, dobara nahi dikhega. Kho jaye to election admin ko message kijiye.

  7. That is all for now. Wait for the message saying everyone has registered. Abhi ke liye itna hi. Us message ka intezaar kijiye jo kahega ke sab log register ho gaye.

    Open this same link any time and press the countdown button to see how long is left. Yahi link kabhi bhi kholiye aur countdown wala button dabakar dekhiye ki kitna waqt baaki hai.

Part two, on election day. Vote Doosra kaam, election ke din. Vote kijiye

  1. Open the same link. Wahi link kholiye.

  2. Type your voting code and press Continue. Apna voting code likhiye aur Continue dabaiye.

    Nothing else is asked for on the day. The code in your hand is the only thing you need. Us din aur kuch nahi poocha jayega. Sirf aapke paas ka code kaafi hai.

  3. You will see every name, with that person's phone number under it. Tap to choose exactly 17. Aapko har naam dikhega, aur uske neeche us aadmi ka phone number. Theek 17 naam chuniye.

  4. Press Review my choices and check your list. Review my choices dabaiye aur apni list dekhiye.

  5. Press Confirm and submit my vote. Confirm and submit my vote dabaiye.

Exactly 17 names. Not one less, not one more Theek 17 naam. Na ek kam, na ek zyada

You have to choose exactly 17 names. This is not a suggestion. With 16 the screen will not let you go forward, and it will not let you choose an 18th at all. Aapko theek 17 naam chunne hain. Yeh sirf salaah nahi hai. 16 par screen aage badhne hi nahi degi, aur 18va naam chunne bhi nahi degi.

The screen counts for you. It says 16 of 17 selected until you are done, so you never have to count the names yourself. Screen aapke liye ginti karti hai. Jab tak poora na ho, likha aata hai 16 of 17 selected, isliye aapko khud ginne ki zaroorat nahi.

Two men can have the same name, so each name carries that person's phone number underneath it. You can also search by that number. Do aadmiyon ka naam ek jaisa ho sakta hai, isliye har naam ke neeche us aadmi ka phone number likha hai. Aap us number se search bhi kar sakte hain.

Chose someone by mistake? Tap that name again to remove it, then choose the one you want. Galti se koi naam chun liya? Us par dobara tap kijiye, woh hat jaayega, phir jo chahiye woh chuniye.

If something goes wrong Agar koi problem ho

Your number is not on the society's list Aapka number society ki list mein nahi hai

What happens You are not turned away. The screen says the election admin has to approve you, and he will. Aapko mana nahi kiya jaata. Screen kehti hai ki election admin ko aapko approve karna hoga, aur woh kar denge.

What to do Check the number first in case a digit is wrong. If it is right, wait, or message the admin. Pehle number check kijiye ki koi digit galat to nahi. Agar sahi hai to intezaar kijiye, ya admin ko message kijiye.

You opened the link again after registering Register karne ke baad aapne link dobara khola

What happens The screen tells you that you are already registered, under your own name. It does not ask you to register a second time, and it does not show your code again. Screen aapko batati hai ki aap pehle se registered hain, aapke apne naam se. Woh dobara register karne ko nahi kehti, aur aapka code dobara nahi dikhati.

What to do Nothing. Press See the countdown to voting and the screen shows exactly how long is left before voting opens. Kuch nahi. See the countdown to voting dabaiye aur screen bata degi ki voting shuru hone mein kitna waqt baaki hai.

You want to see how long is left Aap dekhna chahte hain ki kitna waqt baaki hai

What to do Open the link and press the countdown button. It counts down to the hour voting opens, written in India time. Link kholiye aur countdown wala button dabaiye. Woh voting shuru hone ke waqt tak ginti karega, India time mein likha hua.

What it shows The days and hours left, and the date and hour voting opens, written in India time. Kitne din aur ghante baaki hain, aur voting kis din kis waqt shuru hogi, India time mein likha hua.

You lost your code Aapka code kho gaya

What to do Message the election admin privately. He can read it back to you. Never ask for it in the group. Election admin ko private message kijiye. Woh aapko code bata denge. Group mein kabhi mat maangiye.

The screen says your code cannot be used Screen kehti hai ki aapka code nahi chal sakta

What to do Check every number again. If it still does not work, message the election admin. Do not keep guessing. Har number dobara check kijiye. Phir bhi na chale to election admin ko message kijiye. Baar baar andaaze se mat likhiye.

You typed the wrong code five times Aapne 5 baar galat code likha

What happens Your phone is locked out. This stops strangers guessing other people's codes. Aapka phone lock ho jaata hai. Yeh isliye hai taaki koi anjaan aadmi doosron ke code ka andaaza na laga sake.

What to do Message the election admin. He can unlock your phone in a few seconds. Nothing is lost. Election admin ko message kijiye. Woh kuch hi second mein aapka phone khol denge. Kuch nahi jaata.

Your code has already been used Aapka code pehle hi use ho chuka hai

What happens Each code works once only. The screen never says who has voted, so nobody can use it to check on other people. Har code sirf ek baar chalta hai. Screen kabhi nahi batati ki kisne vote kiya, taaki koi ise doosron par nazar rakhne ke liye use na kar sake.

What to do If you are sure your code is right and you did not vote, tell the admin at once, because somebody may have used it. Agar aapko yakeen hai ki code sahi hai aur aapne vote nahi kiya, to turant admin ko bataiye, kyunki ho sakta hai kisi aur ne use kar liya ho.

The screen says voting has not opened yet Screen kehti hai ki voting abhi shuru nahi hui

What to do You are early. The screen shows the time it opens. Come back then. Aap jaldi aa gaye. Screen par shuru hone ka time dikhta hai. Us time dobara aaiye.

The button will not press Button dab nahi raha

Why You have not chosen exactly 17 names yet, or you have not chosen your country. The screen tells you how many more you need. Aapne abhi theek 17 naam nahi chune, ya desh nahi chuna. Screen batati hai ki kitne aur chunne hain.

It stopped halfway and you do not know if your vote counted Beech mein ruk gaya aur pata nahi vote gina ya nahi

What to do Open the link again and enter your code. If you get the red message, your vote is safely in. If it opens the names, it did not save, so vote again. Link dobara kholiye aur apna code likhiye. Agar red message aaye, to aapka vote safe hai. Agar naam khul jaayein, to vote nahi gaya tha, dobara vote kijiye.

Four things to remember Char zaroori baatein

Never share your code with anyone, and never put it in the group. Whoever has it can vote in your place. Apna code kisi ko mat dijiye, aur group mein kabhi mat daaliye. Jiske paas code hoga, woh aapki jagah vote kar sakta hai.

You can vote once only. Check your list carefully before you confirm. Aap sirf ek baar vote kar sakte hain. Confirm karne se pehle apni list dhyan se dekhiye.

Nobody can see who you voted for. Not the admin, not anyone. Your name and your choices are kept in two separate places with no link between them. Aapne kise vote diya, yeh koi nahi dekh sakta. Na admin, na koi aur. Aapka naam aur aapki pasand do alag jagah rakhi jaati hai, jinmein koi connection nahi hai.

Nobody can see who is winning while voting is open. No count exists until voting closes. Jab tak voting chal rahi hai, koi nahi dekh sakta ki kaun aage hai. Voting band hone tak koi ginti hoti hi nahi.
